solo.name: transfer within balance succeeds
solo.trace:
solo check: transfer within balance succeeds
call: transfer(db, from_id=1, to_id=2, amount=30)
schedule choices: []
step 1   R1  BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED -> BEGIN
step 2   R1  SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock_shared(7310, 2) -> [('',)]
step 3   R1  SELECT balance FROM accounts WHERE id = 1 FOR UPDATE -> [(100,)]
step 4   R1  SELECT balance FROM accounts WHERE id = 2 FOR UPDATE -> [(10,)]
step 5   R1  UPDATE accounts SET balance = balance - 30 WHERE id = 1 -> UPDATE 1
step 6   R1  UPDATE accounts SET balance = balance + 30 WHERE id = 2 -> UPDATE 1
step 7   R1  COMMIT -> COMMIT
         R1  returned True
invariant ok: no balance below zero
invariant ok: expected state: SELECT array_agg(balance ORDER BY id) = '{70,40}' FROM accounts
